quiz.q: 'මම ස්ටේෂන් එකට යනකොට කෝච්චිය ගිහින්' — කොහොමද?
options: The train had left when I got to the station.
The train left when I had got to the station.
The train has left when I got to the station.
The train was leaving when I got to the station.
quiz.explainSi: කලින් වුණු දේට had + past participle.
quiz.speak: The train had left when I got to the station.

quiz.q: 'When I arrived, the party had finished.' — කලින් වුණේ මොකක්ද?
quiz.explainSi: had තියෙන ක්‍රියාව තමයි කලින් වුණේ.
Past perfect එකට did/didn't යෙදෙන්නේ නෑ — hadn't finished.

options: She used to have long hair.
quiz.speak: She used to have long hair.

options: Every evening we would walked on the beach.
Every evening we would walk on the beach.
Every evening we will walk on the beach.
Every evening we would walking on the beach.
quiz.speak: Every evening we would walk on the beach.

quiz.explainSi: walked කියන්නේ past participle — ඒ නිසා had.

options: I have been waiting since an hour.
I have been waiting for an hour.
I have waiting for an hour.
I am waiting since an hour.
quiz.speak: I have been waiting for an hour.

quiz.explainSi: පැය දෙකක් කියන්නේ ප්‍රමාණයක් — 'for two hours'.

quiz.q: 'She has been knowing him for years.' — මේක හරිද?
options: නෑ — 'know' තත්ත්ව ක්‍රියාවක්, 'She has known him for years'
quiz.explainSi: know, be, like, want — තත්ත්ව ක්‍රියාවලට continuous යෙදෙන්නේ නෑ.
wh- වචනය subject එක නම් did යෙදෙන්නේ නෑ.

quiz.q: 'මුලදී මට ඒක අමාරු වුණා, ඒත් දැන් පුරුදුයි' — කුමන වචනයද?
quiz.speak: At first it was hard, but now I'm used to it.

quiz.q: '___ of the film, everybody was crying.' — හිස් තැනට?
quiz.explainSi: දෙයක අන්තිම කොටස — 'At the end of'.

options: By the time I woke up, everyone had gone.
By the time I had woken up, everyone went.
When I woke up, everyone has gone.
Everyone went when I had woken up.
quiz.explainSi: කලින් වුණේ හැමෝම යාම — had gone.
quiz.speak: By the time I woke up, everyone had gone.
